{{Top|leg}}
'''"The Rising Path"''' was the term, roughly translated from [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]] into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], for the period of [[Time/Legends|time]] when young [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] would leave their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] for a period of unsupervised adventures. This period allowed Wookiees to resolve their personal aggression before they were ready to return to Kashyyyk and serve their villages and clans, and was considered a wise policy that avoided the confinement of brash young Wookiees in their small homes. The Wookiee [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] began his rising path at fifty years old in [[150 BBY/Legends|150 BBY]], likely motivated by a need to break free from [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Parent/Legends|father]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk's]] shadow. Chewbacca would only occasionally return to Kashyyyk rather than settle down permanently.<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
"The Rising Path" was mentioned in Chewbacca's DataBank entry in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.<ref name="GB" />
